units.source_text: “大概本地人要举行宴会，今晚不能来了。”

en.t: I probably can't come tonight; the local people are holding a banquet.

units.source_text: 当天晚上驹子来到岛村的房间告诉他又走了。

en.t: That evening Komako came to Shimamura's room to tell him, then left again.

units.source_text: 不久大厅里就响起了鼓声，不时扬起了女人的尖叫声。

en.t: Before long, drums began sounding in the hall, and from time to time women's shrill cries rose up.

units.source_text: 在一片喧嚣中，意外地从近处传来了清越的嗓音。

en.t: Amid the commotion, unexpectedly, a clear, ringing voice came from nearby.
